units.source_en: “Lord Oda, the young lord is speaking. Please conduct yourself with restraint.”

ja.t: ねになっているのです。

units.source_zh: “织田大人，少君正在问话呢，请你自重些。”

units.source_en: Lady Yodo loudly checked Uraku, then turned back and said, “My lord, let us hear the Ichinokami’s thoughts until we understand them fully.”
units.source_zh: 淀夫人大声阻止了有乐，回头道，“少君，且听听市正的想法，直到明白为止。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “织田大人，少君正在问话呢，请你自重些。”淀夫人大声阻止了有乐，回头道，“少君，且听听市正的想法，直到明白为止。”

paragraphs.source_en: Hideyori nodded vigorously. “When you go to Sunpu, what do you mean to say to the retired shogun? We hear that he is exceedingly angry, and that is what troubles everyone now.”

units.source_en: Hideyori nodded vigorously. “When you go to Sunpu, what do you mean to say to the retired shogun?

units.source_en: We hear that he is exceedingly angry, and that is what troubles everyone now.”

units.source_zh: 听说大御所甚是震怒，现在大家担心的就是这个。”

paragraphs.source_zh: 秀赖使劲点头，“你去骏府之后，欲对大御所说些什么？听说大御所甚是震怒，现在大家担心的就是这个。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Quite so.”

units.source_en: “Quite so.”
units.source_zh: “有理。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “有理。”

paragraphs.source_en: “By calling it a postponement, they implicitly mean that, if we have a defense to offer, they are willing to hear it. As matters stand, Sunpu has not barred every path to us. Such is the Ichinokami’s belief.”

units.source_en: “By calling it a postponement, they implicitly mean that, if we have a defense to offer, they are willing to hear it.
units.source_zh: “所谓延期，言外之意，便是若有申辩，不妨听上一听。

units.source_en: As matters stand, Sunpu has not barred every path to us. Such is the Ichinokami’s belief.”
units.source_zh: 于今看来，骏府并未把全部的路都堵死，市正乃是这般想的。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “所谓延期，言外之意，便是若有申辩，不妨听上一听。于今看来，骏府并未把全部的路都堵死，市正乃是这般想的。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Then what will you say?”

units.source_en: “Then what will you say?”
units.source_zh: “那么，你欲怎说？”

paragraphs.source_zh: “那么，你欲怎说？”

paragraphs.source_en: “Since the affair began with Elder Seikan, I intend to take him with me and have him clearly explain the textual source of the phrase, thereby dispelling the misunderstanding.” As he spoke, a strange sense of guilt suddenly arose in Katsumoto, and he felt a voice repeatedly crying out within him: You must not leave this castle now.

units.source_en: “Since the affair began with Elder Seikan, I intend to take him with me and have him clearly explain the textual source of the phrase, thereby dispelling the misunderstanding.”
units.source_zh: “由于事情起于清韩长老，故在下欲把长老一起带去，让他清楚说明字句的出典，以除误会。”

units.source_en: As he spoke, a strange sense of guilt suddenly arose in Katsumoto, and he felt a voice repeatedly crying out within him: You must not leave this castle now.
units.source_zh: 说着，且元忽然产生了一种奇怪的负疚感，只觉一个声音在心中频频向他呼号：眼下，不可离开此城。

paragraphs.source_zh: “由于事情起于清韩长老，故在下欲把长老一起带去，让他清楚说明字句的出典，以除误会。”说着，且元忽然产生了一种奇怪的负疚感，只觉一个声音在心中频频向他呼号：眼下，不可离开此城。

paragraphs.source_en: “Then the whole thing is merely a specter born of suspicion? Very well, I shall trouble you to make the journey.”

units.source_en: “Then the whole thing is merely a specter born of suspicion?

ja.t: にすぎぬということか。

units.source_zh: “这么说，是疑心生了暗鬼了？

units.source_en: Very well, I shall trouble you to make the journey.”
units.source_zh: 那么，你便辛苦走一趟吧。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “这么说，是疑心生了暗鬼了？那么，你便辛苦走一趟吧。”

paragraphs.source_en: “Yes. I would not feel at ease entrusting it to anyone else. If all goes well, we may yet be in time for the eighteenth. At present, I must make the journey myself.”

units.source_en: “Yes.
I would not feel at ease entrusting it to anyone else.
units.source_zh: 其他人去，在下不甚放心。

units.source_en: At present, I must make the journey myself.”
units.source_zh: 目下，还得在下亲自去一趟。”

paragraphs.source_zh: “是。其他人去，在下不甚放心。若是顺利，许还能赶得上十八日。目下，还得在下亲自去一趟。”

paragraphs.source_en: Hideyori nodded magnanimously and ordered Shigenari to prepare a cup of sake.

units.source_en: Hideyori nodded magnanimously and ordered Shigenari to prepare a cup of sake.
units.source_zh: 秀赖大方地点头，命重成准备酒杯。

paragraphs.source_zh: 秀赖大方地点头，命重成准备酒杯。

paragraphs.source_en: The man of nine parts wisdom who lacked only the final part of ripeness—such was Katagiri Katsumoto!

units.source_en: The man of nine parts wisdom who lacked only the final part of ripeness—such was Katagiri Katsumoto!
units.source_zh: 所谓人有九分聪明，只欠一分火候，片桐且元是也！

paragraphs.source_zh: 所谓人有九分聪明，只欠一分火候，片桐且元是也！

paragraphs.source_en: At Lady Yodo’s urging, it was decided that Katsumoto would be sent to Sunpu, and the assembly again lapsed into uneasy silence. Uraku occasionally gave a contemptuous snort but said no more, while Watanabe Kurōdo glared wrathfully.

units.source_en: At Lady Yodo’s urging, it was decided that Katsumoto would be sent to Sunpu, and the assembly again lapsed into uneasy silence.
units.source_zh: 在淀夫人的主张下，派且元去骏府的事决定下来，一座人又陷入了不安的沉默。

units.source_en: Uraku occasionally gave a contemptuous snort but said no more, while Watanabe Kurōdo glared wrathfully.
units.source_zh: 有乐不时冷哼，却不再发话，渡边内藏助则怒目睨视。

paragraphs.source_zh: 在淀夫人的主张下，派且元去骏府的事决定下来，一座人又陷入了不安的沉默。有乐不时冷哼，却不再发话，渡边内藏助则怒目睨视。

paragraphs.source_en: It was at that very moment that the thought of eliminating Katsumoto arose in Kurōdo’s mind. He believed Katsumoto had become utterly ungrateful and now posed a mortal threat to Osaka; whether the man had been in league with Edo from the beginning or had been beguiled during their repeated meetings was no longer worth investigating.

units.source_en: It was at that very moment that the thought of eliminating Katsumoto arose in Kurōdo’s mind.
units.source_zh: 内藏助心中产生了除掉且元的念头，即是生于此时。

units.source_en: He believed Katsumoto had become utterly ungrateful and now posed a mortal threat to Osaka; whether the man had been in league with Edo from the beginning or had been beguiled during their repeated meetings was no longer worth investigating.

units.source_zh: 他以为，且元已完全变成了忘恩负义之人，成了大坂的心腹之患，此人究竟是从一开始就与江户串通，还是在频频会晤中受了迷惑，已无查证的必要了。

paragraphs.source_zh: 内藏助心中产生了除掉且元的念头，即是生于此时。他以为，且元已完全变成了忘恩负义之人，成了大坂的心腹之患，此人究竟是从一开始就与江户串通，还是在频频会晤中受了迷惑，已无查证的必要了。

paragraphs.source_en: The two Ōno brothers were in still greater confusion. Harufusa had already become an advocate of war, while Harunaga still wavered.

paragraphs.source_en: Amid fear, anxiety, and doubt, Katagiri Katsumoto accepted the sake bestowed by Hideyori and, the following day, hurriedly set out for Sunpu.
